# CloudoX

> The intelligent cloud knowledge platform.

CloudoX helps cloud consultants, architects, and engineers understand unfamiliar AWS environments in under 30 minutes and generate stakeholder-ready discovery reports — without inventing architecture or ownership.

## What CloudoX does

- Scans AWS Organizations across accounts and regions with read-only access
- Combines deep per-service collectors with a broader sweep across the rest of the account, and reports coverage and gaps honestly
- Builds a typed knowledge graph from AWS-native sources (Config, Organizations, Resource Explorer, service APIs, resource tags)
- Runs deterministic interpretation: environment classification, internet-exposure analysis, workload grouping
- Generates a structured Markdown discovery report, architecture diagrams, and a hosted dashboard — all rendered from the same knowledge graph
- Adds early consumption layers on top of the graph: Environment Evolution (what changed between two runs) and Cost Intelligence (spend explained in architectural context)
- Runs a built-in quality check over the generated report to flag claims that aren't grounded in the evidence

## Who it is for

- Consultants and solutions architects doing environment discovery at the start of an engagement
- Cloud engineers inheriting an unfamiliar AWS account or Organization
- Cloud platform and SRE teams auditing their own AWS footprint

## Key principles

- Evidence-based: every finding cites AWS-native data or is explicitly labeled as inferred/unknown
- Read-only: CloudoX never creates, modifies, or deletes anything in a customer environment
- Deterministic-first: AI is used for summarization and classification, not for inventing facts
- Multi-account and multi-region by design

## Product status

- AWS-first today; multi-cloud (Azure, GCP) is on the roadmap
- Environment Evolution and Cost Intelligence ship as first versions; continuous/scheduled discovery remains on the roadmap
- Currently in early access with a small group of consultants and engineers
